correctness.rationale: Li–Wang–Yu Section 2 proves realization with all dihedral angles below pi/2+arcsin(4/R), for any finite truncation length and arbitrarily large R. The facet triples follow by induction on deleting a cubic apex and adding three vertices; graph edges correspond precisely to two shared facet labels. The explicit H potential is 3-Lipschitz per edge, checked by the truncation induction and reproduced in exact integer arithmetic. Therefore base-to-tip distance >=ceil((2k-1)/3). Three-connectivity, Euler and V<=2f-4 imply every diameter D<=floor((V+1)/3)<=floor(2f/3)-1. The formulas agree for f=k+2, including base k=2. No finite computation is used as proof of an infinite statement.
